about: Breaks of the long run that a release may carry: each a known bug, deferred to the issue it names. A break matches an entry by its invariant and its shape, both; a matched break is KNOWN (kept with its evidence and the issue), and a run whose only breaks are KNOWN passes, said 'PASS with N known'. Any other break fails the run, one of a known invariant in another shape too. The list is read into cf-evals when it is built (crates/cf-evals/src/long_run/known.rs).

known.what: ConsensFlow's note that a worker's turn left background work running, and that it was ended, reaches the chief after the turn's result instead of with it or before it.
known.issue: Field report A3 of 2026-10-15 (the brain's field reports): turn-end's bug, deferred to 3.0.6 by the lead's decision of 2026-10-17 on long runs.
